name: Café Restaurant Waidmannsheil
kurzbeschreibung: Café Restaurant Waidmannsheil in Bad Hindelang Welcome to Café Restaurant Waidmannsheil, a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of the Allgäu Alps, just steps away from the charming…
beschreibung: The Café Restaurant Waidmannsheil in the Hinterstein valley offers authentic alpine hospitality paired with regional cuisine. Diners can enjoy hearty game dishes, traditional Tyrolean favorites, fresh salads, and homemade pastries. Whether dining inside the rustic alpine stube or relaxing on the sunny panorama terrace, guests are treated to friendly service and delicious mountain comfort food.
